contention_note: results with contended_timing=true had their PORT wall clock measured concurrently with the user's live 12-13-process MPI job (engine_win64_impi); wall clocks are upper bounds. Per-case impi process counts are in each record's impi_procs field. Parity classes and channel rel-RMS are deterministic and unaffected; a borderline case can only be pushed to SKIPPED-SLOW if contention exhausts the 900 s port budget.
comparison_note: Fortran reference CSVs are CARRIED from M37 (deterministic solver, unchanged binaries/decks, byte-identical re-run verified); the port side is a FRESH M38 run. Channels are compared over the OVERLAP window [0, min(fortran, port) final time] interpolated onto the port grid (same semantics as M36/M37). port_time_coverage = port final time / the deck's /RUN target; results < 1 carry a MATCH/DEVIATION label for only that fraction of the simulation.
